Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Midpoint of the published 1–3 March 2017 ship section at 90°E from 2°S to 2°N; not a permanent current centerline or endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: Observed across a 2°S–2°N section at 90°E on 1–3 March 2017; the reported ~13.5 Sv is section transport, not path length. A later review describes the Indian expression as weaker and seasonally varying; one campaign does not establish a permanent path.
